primary.label: Miss + Maintain (strong negative)
primary.stance: Short the bounce or sit out longs
primary.entry: Short on T+1 bounce to VWAP, OR enter on T+2 if T+1 holds red
primary.rationale: Miss with no forward apology = capitulation hasn't started. Continuation move down is the typical pattern. Don't try to catch the knife on T+1 open.
falsification: Sector rally swallows single-stock weakness
Surprise positive catalyst (M&A, large order) hits the tape

plan.label: Miss + Raise (mixed)
plan.stance: Conditional — light long after stabilisation if forward look is credible
plan.entry: After T+1 closes, if forward bump is articulated clearly on the concall: small long T+2 open, sized half a normal trade.
plan.target: Recovery to pre-print level over T+3 to T+5; partial at +3%
plan.rationale: Headline miss + raised guidance is rare. Often miss is one-time (FX, deferral, base effect). If management is credibly bullish on forward, the dip can be a buy. Treat as an edge case.
falsification: Forward bump is vague or qualified
Multiple analyst downgrades land during T+1 — momentum is too negative to fight

plan.label: Miss + Maintain (strong negative)
plan.stance: Short the bounce or sit out longs

plan.rationale: Miss with no forward apology = capitulation hasn't started. Continuation move down is the typical pattern. Don't try to catch the knife on T+1 open.
falsification: Sector rally swallows single-stock weakness

plan.label: Miss + Cut (worst — multi-week down)
plan.stance: Strong short — multi-week downtrend; do not catch the knife
plan.entry: Short on any bounce to VWAP through T+5; scale in over multiple sessions
plan.stoploss: Above the post-result high; 4% above entry as backstop
plan.target: -8–15% over T+5 to T+15; partial at first major support
plan.rationale: Worst cell. Both backward AND forward narratives confirm decay. Analyst downgrades cluster T+1–T+5. The drift is reliable. The only risk is sector or macro reversal — sector rotation can save even bad single-stock setups.
falsification: Macro tailwind shifts capital toward beaten-down names
Surprise activist / takeover bid
Sector rallies 5%+ in the drift window
